title: Pricing · add-ons (bundled rows)
description: ServiceWand add-ons rendered as horizontal rows grouped by category (Capacity / Usage / Service). Each row exposes a glyph marker, body, quantity meter, price column and Add CTA. Second-opinion variant alongside pricing.addons (which uses a card grid).

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only — credit/add-on rows. Visual language normalized to ServiceWand lab-ui tokens; layout switched from card grid to horizontal grouped rows.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — keep add-ons separate from plans so capacity, usage, and service units can become CRM-managed later.

notes: Add-on rows and entire groups can be hidden via *_visible ENUMs; nothing is removed structurally so editors can re-enable later.
Glyph is a single character (B/T/R/A/I/X) sized into a 52px marker tile. Editors can use a different letter without touching CSS.
Featured rows lift to a cyan ring and a filled CTA; muted rows go dashed and gray to signal 'optional' or 'sales-qualified'.
Block is intentionally toggle-free — add-on pricing in stage 1 is per-pack, not per billing cycle.
